verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: COVID-19 is a disease caused by a virus, not by 5G mobile technology. Numerous scientific and health organizations have confirmed there is no link between 5G and the spread of the coronavirus.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple independent fact-checking organizations, including Full Fact, AP News, AFP Fact Check, and FACTLY, have debunked the claim that 5G technology spreads the coronavirus. The evidence confirms that COVID-19 is caused by a virus and there is no scientific basis or evidence to support a link between the disease and 5G mobile networks. One scientific paper that attempted to make this link was later retracted due to a lack of evidence.
